name: Mizu no Senritsu 2 ~Hi no Kioku~
source:
You take control of Kashiwagi Kira, and examine mysterious cases happening around you with a sword. Text reading style is remained, and "Battle Mode" is newly added. Characters from the previous game also appear, including its protagonist Hina.

[From Himeya Shop]
